verdict.encoder_activity_limit: No encoder pulse-count change was observed during CORE_L0. Encoder timing therefore proves the stationary read path; moving-wheel callback contention was not exercised.
verdict.interpretation_limit: Measured costs are direct standalone hardware evidence with all three core peripheral owners active. They do not include camera/person/capture/command/observer/control-layer interaction from the resident runtime.
